After you help [[Devona]] defeat the [[Grawl]] attack in [[Trouble in the Woods]], [[Prince Rurik]] asks that you investigate how the [[Vatlaaw Doomtooth|Charr Ranger]] seen leading the Grawl attack is getting into [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|Ascalon]] without anyone the wiser.  

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
| complete = [[Trouble in the Woods]]
}}

===Objectives===
* Find out if the Charr Ranger is using the [[catacombs]]. Speak to [[Brother Mhenlo]] in [[Ashford Abbey]].
* Ask [[Necromancer Munne]] if she has any information on the [[Charr]].
* Seek out [[Oberan the Reviled]] deep within the catacombs. Ask him about the Charr Ranger.
* Return to Rurik in [[Ascalon City (pre-Searing)|Ascalon City]] and show him the [[Sharp Charr Tooth|sharp charr tooth]].

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Take the southwest road from Ascalon City to Ashford Abbey and speak with Brother Mhenlo. From there, enter the Catacombs; you will find Necromancer Munne just inside to your right.

Oberan the Reviled is a bit harder to get to from Necromancer Munne's position, as you have to fight your way through various undead and [[Deadly Crypt Spider]]s (use the quest marker on the [[Mission Map]] as a reference point).

Alternatively, entering the Catacombs from the [[Green Hills County]] portal (north of [[the Barradin Estate]]) offers a much faster and safer trek to Oberan.

Once you obtain the Sharp Charr Tooth from him, you can simply [[map travel]] back to Ascalon City for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Prince Rurik
:''"This Charr agent that you and Devona witnessed leading the Grawl worries me greatly. I've questioned the guards and many of the townsfolk, but none have seen him. I suspect that he is using the catacombs to move through the countryside unseen. My men are all busy safeguarding the Wall, and I can spare none of them. If you are willing, I'd like you to go into the '''catacombs''' to see if you can find any evidence as to where this '''Charr''' is hiding. Perhaps '''Brother Mhenlo''' at the Abbey has seen something."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will find the evidence you seek.
| decline = That sounds too risky.
| ask = Ask '''Brother Mhenlo''' if he has seen this '''Charr Ranger''' near the catacombs.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Brother Mhenlo
:''"A Charr Ranger south of the Wall? Rurik is right to be worried. I have seen nothing, but perhaps Mistress Munne can offer you some assistance. She is much more familiar with the catacombs than I."''

;Necromancer Munne
:''"Rurik is wise to suspect the Charr of moving through the catacombs. They are fraught with much danger, but if you were familiar with them they could lead you to almost any region in Ascalon. Seek out my associate Oberan the Reviled. He makes his home deep in the catacombs and will know if any Charr have ventured there."''

;Oberan the Reviled
:''"You come here seeking Charr? You were wise to seek out Oberan, for no creature, be they living or dead, moves through here without my knowledge. This Charr that you seek comes often to the underground, but he does not make his lair here. The spirits of this place would not tolerate him should he seek to take up residence. If you require proof of his presence, take this...it's a token he left behind during one of his encounters with the denizens of this place. Now then, leave me to my studies. Return to the world of light."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Prince Rurik
:''"This is proof enough. You have served Ascalon well this day. I will mobilize the troops and search for this beast."''

==Notes==
*This is a good way to get to Oberan the Reviled for [[Necromancer]]s to grab the skill quest [[The Accursed Path]], as this quest leads you straight to him.
